capabilities: Display a searchable, categorised cheatsheet of all assigned hotkeys
Filter shortcuts by modifier, key, conflict, or modified-from-default
Sort the cheatsheet by category, modifier, key, or most-used
Track local per-keystroke usage counts and show usage badges
Export the cheatsheet as an Obsidian note or HTML file
extras: Usage tracking is off by default and counts keystrokes locally only; the README warns against syncing usage-data.json across devices because counts would be mixed or overwritten. A backlog of planned features is listed.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in hotkey settings show a flat alphabetical list of 250+ commands. This plugin gives you a visual overview instead
problem: Obsidian's built-in hotkey settings show a flat alphabetical list of 250+ commands that is hard to scan and offers no filtering by modifier, key, or usage.
summary: Searchable cheatsheet modal that displays all your Obsidian hotkeys with OS-aware key badges, filters, sorting, and optional local usage tracking.
